narrative: The page has several accessibility issues including insufficient color contrast for key links and missing alt text for images. Some elements have vague link text that doesn't clearly indicate their purpose. The page title is descriptive but could be more specific. A few elements have background colors that cannot be determined due to image nodes, requiring manual review.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.75 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #d4622f, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
findings.note: The 'Book online' link has insufficient color contrast of 3.75:1 (4.5:1 required) with a background of #d4622f and white text. This makes it difficult for users with low vision to see.
findings.suggested_fix: Increase the contrast by changing the background color to a lighter shade or increasing the font size. A background of #f5f5f5 with white text would achieve a 4.5:1 ratio.

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.47:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #ffffff, surrounding text: #cfd6d9)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
findings.note: The 'Privacy policy' link has insufficient color contrast of 1.47:1 and lacks visible styling (like underline) to distinguish it from surrounding text. This makes it hard for users with low vision to identify.
findings.suggested_fix: Improve the contrast ratio and add visible styling (like an underline or different font weight) to make the link stand out from the surrounding text.
